_provenance.note: The finale card now holds nine bouts — backfill window B-2005 loaded them — so BOTH finals are VERIFIED against our own ufc_bout_results rows rather than sourced. Our records and the season source agree exactly on both: Griffin over Bonnar by unanimous decision in round three, and Sanchez over Florian by TKO in round one at 2:49. Nothing is imported; the card's bouts live on the event page and are linked, not restated.

_conflicts.detail: The source lists Bobby Southworth as both a quarter-final winner (over Lodune Sincaid) and a quarter-final loser (to Stephan Bonnar) in the same round, and asserts Sam Hoger reached the semi-finals without naming a bout. The three stated bouts are recorded; the round is marked partial rather than reordered into something the source does not say.

Diego Sanchez is listed twice in the quarter-finals, against Alex Karalexis and against Josh Rafferty, and Kenny Florian is placed in the semi-finals without a stated bout. Recorded as given, marked partial.
Marc Laimon, Ganyao Fairtex and Peter Welch are listed as assistant coaches for the season without being assigned to a team. Recorded without a team rather than guessed onto one.
